aboutPreview.title: A studio built on the work Maria Victoria loves
aboutPreview.body: VM Integral Massage Inc. was founded in 2021 by Maria Victoria Malacre — proof that when you are passionate about your work, your clients’ satisfaction and loyalty are the reward.

aboutPage.title: Who we are
aboutPage.tagline: A place where you can relax and enjoy.
aboutPage.experience: At VM Integral Massage we have more than 17 years of experience in therapeutic massage for the treatment of many kinds of body pain. Our focus is to improve the health, physical wellbeing, and quality of life of our clients.
aboutPage.commitment: Our commitment is to provide a high-quality service, putting the client first through integral massage, together with the respect, value, and care each person needs.
aboutPage.experts: We are also experts in lymphatic drainage massage.
aboutPage.mission1: Because we love our work, we are committed to our clients’ wellbeing. We take the time to understand each person’s individual needs and health, creating an atmosphere of trust and a personalized experience focused on physical and emotional health.
aboutPage.mission2: We offer our clients relaxation therapy, post-operative lymphatic drainage massage, massage for injury therapy, and more. In every service, clients receive kind, professional, personalized, high-quality care.
aboutPage.mission3: Client reviews of the massage therapy and services we provide have ‘5.0 stars’ on Google. That is testimony of satisfaction and proof of our experience, integrity, and excellent service.
aboutPage.galleryIntro: Treatment-room photographs from the studio, including lymphatic drainage with pressotherapy.
aboutPage.resultsIntro: Before-and-after photographs previously published on the About page of the live site. They show real post-operative recovery; some images include clinical nudity with the stickers already applied by the studio.
aboutPage.resultsNote: These photos were copied from the public WordPress gallery. Additional gallery files remain in the previous media library if you want a larger set later.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: VM Integral Massage Inc. is a local massage studio. This page describes how we handle the information you choose to send when you book.
privacyPage.body1: Appointments are requested by WhatsApp, phone, or email. We use the name, phone number, and message you send only to answer you and to schedule care.
privacyPage.body2: This website does not include an account system or a booking database. Choosing English or Spanish simply opens the matching pages.
